meta.title: Incremental Sync with Metadata Cache
meta.purpose: Provide current code state and implementation hints for incremental sync development

problem.description: Full directory tree scan on every sync operation
problem.impact: 3-5 second delays on every project entry (CC-001)

problem.description: No caching of file metadata (mtime, size, content hash)

finding.summary: Dexie v9 supports compound indexes and multi-entry indexes for efficient queries
finding.implication: fileMetadata table should use compound index on [path,mtime] for efficient lookups
These patterns must be checked against metadata cache entries

finding.summary: FileSystemHandle provides kind property (file/directory) and lastModified
finding.implication: Can use FSA API metadata for cache population

hint.description: Create FileMetadataCacheService class that wraps Dexie helpers
Modify SyncManager to use cache-first approach
Add content hash computation for large files (>1MB)
hint.algorithm: Use SubtleCrypto SHA-256 for content hashing

integration.scenario: Full sync → change file → incremental sync
